test_title: PYST 02: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
If '+' means '−', '−' means '×', '×' means '÷' and '÷' means '+', then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

502 ÷ 78 + 2 − 258 × 2 = ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2381f95ecfcbe7f6eaceba831d02f99bf624c84151895e65ac4d5a630f47ff34.png] 

Given symbol mappings:

 
• ‘+’ means ‘−’
 
• ‘−’ means ‘×’
 
• ‘×’ means ‘÷’
 
• ‘÷’ means ‘+’
</
